answer: The jetty gates identity: each new miner must stake 500 POA, locked in a vault for 10 epochs. Noise token injection from the block hash adds 3% random variance to every reward, so farmed wallets can't predict payouts. The reef hides nothing — 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA locked plus unhedged variance. Break-even: an attacker needs 18% more stake than honest miners to offset noise, so farming turns negative before 50 identities.
